plugins.name: proof-os
plugins.description: A trust layer for AI work. Derives your project's real connection graph, runs executable gates so 'done' means proved (not believed), journals every change with who/what/when, turns failures into permanent checks, and cleans up working files when tasks close. Skills are tenants; this is the landlord.
